questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 令}x=\tan t\ (-\frac{\pi}{2}<t<\frac{\pi}{2})\text{,则}\sqrt{1+x^{2}}=\sqrt{1+\tan^{2}t}=\frac{1}{\cos t}\text{, }dx=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}t}\,dt\,,\\&\text{所以}I=\int\frac{\frac{1}{\cos^{2}t}\,dt}{\frac{\sin^{2}t}{\cos^{2}t}\frac{1}{\cos t}}=\int\frac{\cos t}{\sin^{2}t}dt=\int\frac{d\sin t}{\sin^{2}t}=-\frac{1}{\sin t}+C\,.\\&\text{由于}\sin t=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}\,(-\frac{\pi}{2}<t<\frac{\pi}{2})\text{,因此}I=-\frac{\sqrt{1+x^{2}}}{x}+C.\end{aligned}
